notes: «قالا» makes Abu Bakr and Ali the co-transmitters of the first level
«- قال وكيع وأثنى عليه خيرا -» is an editor's gloss between dashes, left out
«قال علي الطنافسي يعني عرضه» is a commentary, not a link; «وبر» is part of the name, not the conjunction
«عن أبيه» is a bare relation: the Companion's father, not named in the text
